# Kommunicate

Kommunicate is a customer support platform for managing conversations, users, messages, and agent assignments across human and AI support workflows.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/kommunicate/.

## Actions

- **Change Conversation Assignee**: Assign one Kommunicate conversation to a human agent, changing live routing.
- **Change Conversation Status**: Change one Kommunicate conversation to open, closed, or spam.
- **Create Conversation**: Create a persistent Kommunicate conversation with the specified members.
- **Get User Details** (read-only): Return details for one or more specified Kommunicate user IDs.
- **Send Message**: Immediately send one plain-text message to a Kommunicate conversation as a specified user.
- **Update User Details**: Update selected profile fields for one explicitly identified non-agent Kommunicate user.
